hypothesis: Same-query positive/known-negative gradients accumulated before updating reduce branch-separated recall bias and improve conditional rejection. This is not demonstrated.
sampling_contract: Select positive-eligible queries with unchanged document/query coverage ordering; each appears once before repeats
Each pair uses exact same query crop and one positive and one reviewed-negative center when eligible
For positive-only query, pair two genuine positive-center crops and disclose fallback; never invent negatives
Identical ordered queries, center draws, crops and targets in P0/P1; optimizer timing alone differs
steps counts forward crop attempts; track successful forwards and optimizer updates separately
Pairs and accumulation require even step/save boundaries; checkpoint only after committed optimizer update

gates: preserved all-ones model mask and zero loss gradients on unknown/query/context/padding
measured peak memory and zero swaps; no concurrent numerical workload
exact source/model/manifest hashes and actual parameter-scope proof

implementation_proof: Legacy random/coverage with accumulation1 retains prior behavior
Identical pair IDs and order for both arms
Known-negative-only center selection and positive-only fallback
Gradient equals mean of two masked crop losses before optimizer step
Per-crop control performs two updates; accumulated candidate one
Interrupted/end checkpoint cannot save partial accumulated gradients
